notes: Migrate google-generativeai (legacy Gemini Python SDK) to google-genai (Google GenAI SDK). Package rename is DEPENDENCY_REMOVE + DEPENDENCY_ADD; import path google.generativeai → google.genai. GenerativeModel → Client.models.generate_content is multi-statement and is listed under side_effects, not fake-passed by string rewrite. Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/migrate

side_effects.detail: Replace genai.configure(api_key=...) with genai.Client(api_key=...) or GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY env; configure has no 1:1 callee.

Replace model = genai.GenerativeModel('...'); model.generate_content(...) with client = genai.Client(); client.models.generate_content(model=..., contents=...). Same for start_chat → client.chats.create, count_tokens, and generate_content_stream.
generation_config=genai.GenerationConfig(...) becomes config=types.GenerateContentConfig(...); system_instruction moves into config. Add `from google.genai import types` when using typed config.
Module-level helpers genai.upload_file / list_files / get_file / delete_file / embed_content become client.files.* / client.models.embed_content (needs a Client).

rules.reason: Legacy package EOL path; replace with google-genai per Google migrate guide.
Official Google GenAI SDK successor package (PyPI google-genai).
Import path changes from google.generativeai to google.genai (from google import genai).
Catch remaining string/module references after AST import rewrite.
Legacy GenerationConfig renamed to GenerateContentConfig in google.genai.types.
embed_content kwarg content → contents in the new SDK.
files.upload uses file= instead of path=.
AFC is default in new SDK generate_content/chat; start_chat flag is gone.
